content: Amoxicillin capsules are available in two strengths: 250 mg and 500 mg. Each capsule contains amoxicillin in the form of its trihydrate. The 250 mg capsules are yellow with an opaque cap and body, size 2, and are imprinted with RX654 on both the cap and body. These are supplied in bottles of 20 (NDC 63304-654-20), 30 (NDC 63304-654-30), 100 (NDC 63304-654-01), 500 (NDC 63304-654-05), and unit-dose packs of 100 (NDC 63304-654-77). The 500 mg capsules have a maroon opaque cap and a yellow opaque body, size 0-el, and are imprinted with RX655 on both the cap and body. These are supplied in bottles of 12 (NDC 63304-762-82), 20 (NDC 63304-762-20), 100 (NDC 63304-762-01), 120 (NDC 63304-762-13), and 500 (NDC 63304-762-05). Amoxicillin tablets are available in two strengths: 500 mg and 875 mg. Each tablet contains amoxicillin in the form of its trihydrate. The 500 mg tablets are pink, film-coated, capsule-shaped, and debossed with RX762 on one side, with the other side plain. These are supplied in bottles of 12 (NDC 63304-762-82), 20 (NDC 63304-762-20), 100 (NDC 63304-762-01), 120 (NDC 63304-762-13), and 500 (NDC 63304-762-05). The 875 mg tablets are pink, film-coated, capsule-shaped, and debossed with RX763 on one side and scored on the reverse side. These are supplied in bottles of 12 (NDC 63304-763-82), 20 (NDC 63304-763-20), 100 (NDC 63304-763-01), 120 (NDC 63304-763-13), and 500 (NDC 63304-763-05). Amoxicillin chewable tablets are available in four strengths: 125 mg, 200 mg, 250 mg, and 400 mg. Each chewable tablet contains amoxicillin in the form of its trihydrate. The 125 mg chewable tablets are pink, strawberry-flavored, oval, biconvex, with a mottled appearance, and debossed with RX514 on one side. These are supplied in bottles of 100 (NDC 63304-514-01) and 500 (NDC 63304-514-05). The 200 mg chewable tablets are light pink, strawberry-flavored, circular, flat-faced, with beveled edges and a mottled appearance, and debossed with RX760 on one side. These are supplied in bottles of 20 (NDC 63304-760-20), 100 (NDC 63304-760-01), and 500 (NDC 63304-760-05). The 250 mg chewable tablets are pink, strawberry-flavored, circular, flat-faced, with beveled edges and a mottled appearance, and debossed with RX515 on one side. These are supplied in bottles of 30 (NDC 63304-515-30), 100 (NDC 63304-515-01), and 250 (NDC 63304-515-04). The 400 mg chewable tablets are light pink, strawberry-flavored, circular, flat-faced, with beveled edges and a mottled appearance, and debossed with RX716 on one side. These are supplied in bottles of 20 (NDC 63304-761-20), 100 (NDC 63304-761-01), and 500 (NDC 63304-761-05). Amoxicillin for oral suspension is available in two concentrations: 200 mg per 5 mL and 400 mg per 5 mL. The 200 mg per 5 mL suspension is an off-white to light orange granular powder that forms a light orange to orange suspension with a fruity flavor upon reconstitution with water. It is supplied in 50 mL bottles (NDC 63304-969-03), 75 mL bottles (NDC 63304-969-01), and 100 mL bottles (NDC 63304-969-04). The 400 mg per 5 mL suspension is an off-white to light orange granular powder that forms a light orange to orange suspension with a fruity flavor upon reconstitution with water. It is supplied in 50 mL bottles (NDC 63304-970-03), 75 mL bottles (NDC 63304-970-01), and 100 mL bottles (NDC 63304-970-04). The oral suspension must be shaken well before use. The bottle should be kept tightly closed, and any unused portion of the reconstituted suspension must be discarded after 14 days. Refrigeration is preferable but not required. Amoxicillin capsules (250 mg and 500 mg), tablets (500 mg and 875 mg), chewable tablets (125 mg, 200 mg, 250 mg, and 400 mg), and unreconstituted powder for oral suspension (200 mg/5 mL and 400 mg/5 mL) should be stored at controlled room temperature, between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F), in accordance with USP guidelines.
